paragraphs.text: He shows the hypocrisy of the idolaters, who will pretend to hear the prophets of God, though in their hearts they follow nothing less than their admonitions and also how by one means or another God discovers them.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: They are not only idolaters in heart, but also worship their filthy idols openly which lead them in blindness, and cause them to stumble, so that he will not hear them when they call to him. See Geneva "Isa 1:15"

paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: As his abomination has deserved: that is, he will be led with lies according as he delighted in it, 2Th 2:10.
